text: (1) A foreigner's ordinary passport valid for more than one year or a currently valid visa in China.(2) High school graduation certificate; Fresh graduates can provide a pre-graduation certificate issued by their high school. Those who fail to obtain the graduation certificate before enrollment will have their admission qualification cancelled.(3) The original transcript of the complete high school study period (in English or Chinese or a notarized copy).Applicants who studied in China during their previous educational stage are required to provide proof of their academic performance at school.(5) Physical examination report (The examination results must have a valid official seal and be valid for 6 months).(6) There are additional materials to be supplemented as per the notice.
